A.title: The room from above
A.differs: K-377 draws a line from each thing seen from the side to the same thing seen from above; K-563 (not yet published in English) matches side views to the furniture on a room plan seen from above (four or six things, turned at level 3). Laying paper shapes on a plan of our room is the lesson's.

A.title: Who is in my family?
A.differs: K-370 finds each person on a picture family tree and writes their number next to the family word; K-375 traces and writes the family words. The jobs each person does at home are talk only.

A.title: Community helpers and their tools
A.differs: Draw a line from each helper to the tool they use (doctor and thermometer, firefighter and ladder, farmer and tractor, chef and whisk ...). How the work helps everyone is the lesson's talk.

A.title: Needs and wants
A.differs: Draw a line from each picture to Needs (water, apple, bread, shirt, house) or Wants (ball, doll, candy, television, balloon). Why a family buys needs first is the lesson's talk.

A.title: On land, on water, in the air
A.differs: K-210 draws a line from each vehicle to Land, Water or Air; K-206 sorts things that fly. How people and goods get from place to place is the lesson's talk.

A.title: Family generations
A.differs: G1-385 orders family words from the oldest generation to the youngest; G1-386 reads clues to write each name on the family tree; G1-387 is the child's own tree template (the people who matter, any family shape).

A.title: Read the map key
A.differs: G1-379 finds each key symbol on an island map and writes how many; G1-528 follows step directions on a grid; G1-529 writes the directions of a drawn route; G2-505 fixes the wrong arrow; G1-530 (not yet published in English) draws an own map with a key.

A.title: Prices at the market
A.differs: Built for this line in Stage D-5 batch S1 (2026-11-25): a market stall where each thing has a price tag and a tray of real US coins at real size, exactly one set paying the price; level 1 prices to 10 cents with pennies and a nickel, level 2 to 25 cents with dimes, level 3 to 50 cents with all four coins; then which costs more. It replaces G2-472, whose coins and prices are Grade 2.

A.title: North, south, east and west
A.differs: G2-369 writes the three missing direction letters on compass roses (the north tip given); G2-371 starts at a picture on a map with north at the top, looks the way the word says and circles the picture that lies that way. Giving a partner directions is the lesson's.

A.title: The seven continents
A.differs: Write each numbered continent's name on its line from the box. Finding them on the globe with the oceans between is the lesson's.

A.title: Aunts, cousins and grandparents
A.differs: Read each family riddle (my mother's sister ...) and write the family word from the box; one word can fit more than one riddle. Placing relatives in the right generation of a tree is G1-386's, a grade lower.

A.unit: Maps of Our World and Our State
A.title: Continents and oceans
A.differs: Find each continent and ocean on the world map and write its number next to its name. The questions about the oceans that touch North America and the continent south of Europe are the teacher's.
